title: Final answer for part (1)
description: Essential: States that for a fixed cart with v₀=2.4 m/s, the game fails because the object's stopping distance (1.44 m) exceeds the available length (0.5 m).

title: Friction force calculation
description: Important: Correctly calculates the kinetic friction force as F_f = μ m g, leading to the object's deceleration a₁ = -μ g.

title: Relative motion condition
description: Important: For the moving cart, identifies that success requires the object's relative displacement Δx to satisfy L ≤ Δx ≤ L + d.

title: Conservation of momentum
description: Important: For the moving cart, applies momentum conservation to find the common final velocity of the object and cart.

title: Kinematic equations application
description: Important: Correctly uses kinematic equations (v² = v₀² + 2aΔx, Δx = v₀t + ½at²) for displacements under constant acceleration.

title: Velocity range for part (2)
description: Essential: Correctly states the final condition for success as 2√2 m/s ≤ v₀ ≤ 3√2 m/s.

title: Sign error in acceleration
description: Pitfall: Assigns the wrong sign to the object's acceleration (positive instead of negative) when using kinematic equations.

title: Forgetting relative displacement
description: Pitfall: Compares the object's absolute displacement to the cart's length, instead of its displacement relative to the moving cart.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Shows that all calculations maintain consistent SI units (kg, m, s).
